title: [Northstar FinTech] Webhook payload retry policy & HTTP 429 rate limit clarification (#1)

messages.bodyHtml:
Hello,

Our ingestion worker occasionally returns HTTP 502 during deployment windows. How many times does your webhook dispatcher retry before marking an endpoint disabled?
messages.bodyText:

messages.bodyHtml: Customer is on the Growth Annual plan (Workspace #4491). Checking webhook telemetry logs — 0 dropped events in the last 24h.

Great question! Our webhook delivery engine uses exponential backoff up to 7 retries over 6 hours (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 2h).

title: [Kinetix AI Labs] CSV export truncating at 300 rows & missing full conversation transcript bodies (#3)

messages.bodyHtml:
We need to export 18,400 customer support conversations including full message text and internal notes for our Q4 SOC2 & RAG AI training audit.

The built-in dashboard CSV export only gives metadata columns (no message bodies!) and caps UI searches. How can we get a clean CSV with every reply?
messages.bodyText:
We need to export 18,400 customer support conversations including full message text and internal notes for our Q4 SOC2 & RAG AI training audit.

The built-in dashboard CSV export only gives metadata columns (no message bodies!) and caps UI searches. How can we get a clean CSV with every reply?

messages.bodyHtml: Standard UI export only exports ticket metadata. Recommending the local API v2.11 cursor pagination & N+1 transcript streamer workflow.
messages.bodyText: Standard UI export only exports ticket metadata. Recommending the local API v2.11 cursor pagination & N+1 transcript streamer workflow.

messages.bodyHtml: Because each conversation contains up to 500 nested conversation_parts, full transcript extraction requires iterating through the REST API v2.11 with cursor pagination (starting_after) and streaming directly to disk.
messages.bodyText: Because each conversation contains up to 500 nested conversation_parts, full transcript extraction requires iterating through the REST API v2.11 with cursor pagination (starting_after) and streaming directly to disk.

messages.bodyHtml: Using ChatVault Exporter in a dedicated tab streamed all 18,400 transcripts directly to disk with <30MB RAM and preserved UTF-8 BOM for Excel. Problem solved!
messages.bodyText: Using ChatVault Exporter in a dedicated tab streamed all 18,400 transcripts directly to disk with <30MB RAM and preserved UTF-8 BOM for Excel. Problem solved!

messages.bodyHtml: Awesome to hear! Enjoy the clean CSV, NDJSON, and Obsidian Markdown outputs.
messages.bodyText: Awesome to hear! Enjoy the clean CSV, NDJSON, and Obsidian Markdown outputs.

title: [BluePeak Health] SSO SAML 2.0 assertion error after Okta certificate rotation (#4)

messages.bodyHtml:
Hi Support Team,

We rotated our Okta signing certificate this morning and now 45 users in our EU workspace are getting SAML_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH when logging in.

Here is our metadata reference: Okta SAML Metadata.
Can you help us verify the fingerprint urgently?
messages.bodyText:
Hi Support Team,

We rotated our Okta signing certificate this morning and now 45 users in our EU workspace are getting SAML_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH when logging in.

Here is our metadata reference: Okta SAML Metadata (https://status.example.com/sso-guide).
Can you help us verify the fingerprint urgently?

messages.bodyHtml: [Internal Escalation Note] Checked tenant ID eu-west-8841. Their cached X.509 cert still points to the old SHA-1 thumbprint. Flushing Redis SAML cache now.
messages.bodyText: [Internal Escalation Note] Checked tenant ID eu-west-8841. Their cached X.509 cert still points to the old SHA-1 thumbprint. Flushing Redis SAML cache now.

messages.bodyHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for reaching out.

I located your workspace and flushed the cached X.509 certificate fingerprint on our SAML gateway. Could you please ask one affected user to test an IdP-initiated login now?

  • Clear browser session cookies
  • Re-launch from Okta tile
messages.bodyText:
Hi there! Thanks for reaching out.

I located your workspace and flushed the cached X.509 certificate fingerprint on our SAML gateway. Could you please ask one affected user to test an IdP-initiated login now?

• Clear browser session cookies
• Re-launch from Okta tile

messages.bodyHtml: Tested with 3 engineers across Frankfurt and Dublin — login works immediately now! Thank you for the fast turnaround.
messages.bodyText: Tested with 3 engineers across Frankfurt and Dublin — login works immediately now! Thank you for the fast turnaround.

messages.bodyHtml: Glad to hear everyone is back in! I have also enabled automatic metadata polling for your tenant so future certificate rotations sync seamlessly.
